policies.title: Grenada: Nauruan ordinary passports
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked Embassy nationality schedule directly lists Nauru as not requiring a visitor visa.
conditions: Applies to a current ordinary Nauruan passport for short visitor travel.
The schedule defines No Visa Required as no visa needed for entry and was revised in April 2024; recheck early if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, residence, study, transit, diplomatic, official, special-document and final-admission rules remain separate.

policies.title: Iceland: Nauruan ordinary passports
policies.summary: Iceland's April 2026 regulation moved Nauru into Annex 8's visa-required cohort and removed it from Annex 9's exemption cohort.
conditions: Applies to a current ordinary Nauruan passport for short visitor travel.
The amendment was signed on 7 April, published on 28 April 2026 and took immediate effect upon publication; it expressly changed both the visa-required and visa-exempt annexes.
Family-member rights, residence, long stays, diplomatic or special documents and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Panama: Nauruan ordinary passports
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule expressly includes Nauru in its no-visa-required visitor cohort.
conditions: Applies to a current ordinary Nauruan passport for tourist stays of up to three months.
This passport-wide rule is distinct from Panama's conditional waiver for holders of qualifying third-country visas or residence documents.
Work, residence, study, transit, diplomatic, official, special-document and final-admission rules remain separate.
